function.name: systemMonitor
function.description: Monitor system-wide CPU, memory, IO, threads, and other resources using guider. Available commands: top, ttop, atop, mtop, vtop, wtop, ftop, disktop, irqtop, swaptop, slabtop, stacktop, ctop, cgtop, contop, oomtop, pytop, rtop.

command.description: guider sub-command (e.g. 'ttop' for thread CPU, 'mtop' for memory, 'disktop' for disk IO)

target.description: process name or PID to filter (guider -g option)

function.name: bpfTrace
function.description: eBPF-based kernel/user space tracing. Requires CAP_BPF or root, kernel >=5.8. Commands include: bpftop (function call counts), bpfstacktop (on-CPU stack sampling), bpfwaittop (off-CPU blocking), bpfblktop (block IO latency), bpfrunqtop (runqueue latency), bpfsyscalltop (syscall stats), bpfbinderlat/snoop/pool (Android Binder), and more.

target.description: process name or PID to filter

func_name.description: kernel function name for bpftop or bpfsnoop (e.g. 'do_sys_open')

function.name: ftraceProfile
function.description: ftrace and perf-based kernel function profiling (requires root, kernel >=4.4). Only 1 concurrent ftrace command allowed. Commands: trtop (tracepoint events), tptop, btop/ktop (function top), utop (user-space), ptop (perf), funcrec/btrace/utrace (recording), iorec/filerec/sysrec (IO/file/syscall recording), stat (snapshot).

target.description: process name or PID to filter

function.name: networkTrace
function.description: Network performance tracing including TCP retransmits, packet drops, RTT latency, XDP packet flows, and D-Bus messages.

function.name: androidPerf
function.description: Android performance analysis: Perfetto traces, Binder transaction top (bdtop), ATrace (attop), GPU frames (gfxtop), logcat (logand), CAN bus (cantop/cansnoop), bug reports (bugrec/bugrep), Java heap profiles (hprof), LMK kill events (lmksnoop), stack dumps (dumpstack), system properties (getprop/watchprop), boot info (printboot), and system commands (andcmd).

device_id.description: Android device serial number from 'adb devices'

input_file.description: path to existing trace file for offline analysis (perfetto -I)

target.description: process name or PID to filter (-g); required by sperf/hprof

function.name: memoryAnalyze
function.description: Memory analysis: detect duplicate mappings (checkdup), track user-space leaks (leaktop/leaktrace/mtrace), per-process page-level memory info (mem), and process memory dump (dump).

function.name: visualize
function.description: Generate performance graphs from recorded guider data files. Commands: draw (combined), drawcpu/mem/net/disk (per metric), drawflame (flame graph), drawflamediff (diff flame), drawscatter/hist/violin/stack/bitmap (statistics), drawconn (flow graph), drawpsi (pressure stall), drawreq (latency), drawrss/vss (memory size), drawdelay (scheduling delay), drawio (block I/O), drawleak (memory leak), drawpri (thread priority), averaged variants (drawavg/drawcpuavg/drawmemavg/drawvssavg/drawrssavg), drawdiff, convert.

function.name: logAnalyze
function.description: Log streaming and analysis. Live streaming: logkmsg (kernel), logdlt (DLT), dlttop (DLT aggregated top), logjrl (journald), logsys (syslog). Offline analysis: printkmsg/printdlt/printjrl/printtrace/printand/printsyslog. Format conversion: convlog.

function.name: runCommand
function.description: Generic guider command runner for any whitelisted command not covered by specialized tools. Blocked commands (rejected outright): kill/tkill/freeze/pause/hook/cgroup/swapout/limitcpu*/limitmem*/limitpid/limitread/limitwrite/setafnt/setcpu/setsched/setprop/sysrq/exec/rlimit/remote/ask/chat/embed/rag/cmdtest/server/cli/fserver/hserver/send/event/start/stop/mount/umount. Blocked -q option keys (stripped from otherwise-allowed commands): ASKAI/ASKRUN/AIPERIODIC/LLMPROVIDER/LLMMODEL (LLM loop), EXITCMD/PRINTCMD (command execution), DUPOUTPATH/OUTFILEUSER/OUTFILEPERM (file manipulation), RUNCMDLIST/EVENTCMD/GUIDERCMD/WATCHLOGCMD/REGSIGCMD (arbitrary process/command execution). Use guiderHelp to discover available commands.

function.name: guiderHelp
function.description: List available guider commands and their metadata without running any subprocess. Filter by tool name (e.g. 'bpfTrace') or keyword (e.g. 'tcp'). Call this first to discover which commands to use.

query.description: keyword to search in command names and descriptions

tool_name.description: MCP tool name to list commands for
